nameJa: アウトラインとソリッド
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 輪郭線のFullscreenと、赤い塗りのLive Chatを対比したタイポグラフィ。画面の四隅と文字の輪郭線が呼応する構成。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Design a sophisticated contemporary TYPOGRAPHIC POSTER as a Chrome Web Store promotional tile. Compact landscape 11:7 proportions, target 1760 × 1120, not a panorama. Flat ink-black, warm off-white and signal-red only. Type is the artwork; one spare fullscreen-video/chat diagram is secondary.
Creative idea: a beautifully designed contrast of OUTLINED and SOLID sans-serif lettering. Set “Fullscreen” as a single unbroken line of elegant moderately wide medium-weight outline lettering. The black outline stroke is substantial enough to read at a 220 × 140 thumbnail, not a hairline. Open counters and deliberate optical spacing. Set “Live Chat” as a single strong SOLID red line underneath, in a related medium-weight slightly wider geometric sans. “YouTube” is a substantial solid black label at upper-left, about 80–95px cap-height on a 1572px-wide native image, never a tiny caption. Distinctive but exceptionally readable type design, NOT ultra-condensed, NOT chunky generic Arial.
Layout: all three phrases occupy an intentional typographic grid with generous 8% margins. Integrate a single simple horizontal 16:9 video frame, made from black fullscreen corner marks, behind the negative space beside/below the typography, without crossing any letter. Inside that frame, a small solid black play triangle and one red speech rectangle fully inside its right side, with two off-white abstract short lines. The thin graphic geometry echoes the outlined headline. Preserve breathing space and precise alignment, no ornamental clutter.
Only these exact visible text groups, each once: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. Fullscreen must remain one word, with no spelling errors, line breaks or ambiguous ligatures. No extra words or symbols that resemble labels. All text readable at 220 × 140.
Flat sophisticated graphic design. No 3D, bevel, shadow, glass, grain, texture, glow, gradients, physical paper, photographs, people, avatars, video scenes, UI screenshot, dashboards, decorative badges, watermark or numbers. A real art director's carefully typeset identity poster, not clip art.

revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine ONLY the typographic design of this exact promotional image. Preserve its warm off-white / black / red palette, exact three phrases, outlined-vs-solid concept and secondary video/chat diagram. No new elements.
The present composition is heavy and compressed. Make it spacious and sophisticated: retain the outline “Fullscreen”, but scale its whole word down about 15 percent, leaving generous left and right margins. Its outline is a clean moderate-weight black stroke, still clearly legible at a 220 × 140 thumbnail. Keep the word unbroken and correctly spelled.
Replace the currently very heavy compressed red “Live Chat” with a NORMAL-WIDTH UPRIGHT REGULAR sans. Use weight 300–400 and strokes around ONE THIRD of current stem thickness. Open counters, careful optical kerning, no condensed letters. It should feel light, composed and refined, not loud.
Change “YouTube” from its current heavy bold to a restrained upright REGULAR-weight sans, generous tracking only if natural, still large and immediately readable. No chunky Arial or ultra-condensed fonts.
Keep 11:7 compact landscape canvas, target 1760 × 1120, not a panorama. All three phrases each ONCE must remain exactly: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. No added words, numbers, labels or watermark. Preserve the simple black fullscreen corner symbol with black play triangle and red chat bubble entirely inside, as a smaller secondary element. Ensure it does not touch the letters. All typography must have 8% safe margins and noticeably more air between lines. No 3D, shadows, glass, grain, glow, texture, gradients or effects. One focused transformation from heavy compressed lettering to refined regular typography.
revisions.reason: Reduce heavy typography to light or regular strokes while preserving exact copy and graphic.

refinementReview: Inspected actual saved PNG. Typography is visibly lighter; all three exact phrases are present once, no clipped letters, chat shape fully inside fullscreen boundary.
